text: 8月以来，国际金融市场延续震荡走势，部分经济体债市、汇市等波动加大，我国外汇市场运行稳健。具体看：一是跨境收支规模持续增长，跨境资金保持净流入。8月，企业、个人等非银行部门跨境收支合计1.5万亿美元，延续今年以来较快增长态势。跨境资金净流入624亿美元，环比小幅增长4%。从主要渠道看：一是货物贸易项下资金净流入规模较高。二是暑期留学和旅行增多，推动服务贸易逆差环比增长6%。三是外资企业分红派息环比收窄23%，从季节性高位回落。四是跨境双向直接投资基本稳定。
text_en: Since August, international financial markets have continued their volatile trend, with increased fluctuations in bond and foreign exchange markets in some economies, while China's foreign exchange market has operated steadily. Specifically: first, the scale of cross-border receipts and payments has continued to grow, with cross-border funds maintaining net inflows. In August, cross-border receipts and payments by non-bank entities such as enterprises and individuals totaled 1.5 trillion US dollars, continuing the rapid growth trend since the beginning of this year. Cross-border net fund inflows reached 62.4 billion US dollars, a slight month-on-month increase of 4%. From the main channels: first, net fund inflows under trade in goods were relatively high. Second, increased overseas study and travel during the summer vacation pushed the services trade deficit up 6% month-on-month. Third, dividend and interest payments by foreign-funded enterprises narrowed 23% month-on-month, falling back from a seasonal high. Fourth, cross-border two-way direct investment was basically stable.
